_doc: Stage-0 baseline snapshot committed in-tree as the Stage 7 canary reference. STRUCTURAL fields (component count, fact_validation_*_count, materialise_cardinality_per_owner, candidate_set_size_histogram) are deterministic across machines and must match exactly. TIMING fields (cold_ms / warm_ms / p50 / p95 / p99) are null here because wall-clock latencies are machine-dependent; the canary measures them at canary time and compares against the Stage-0 distribution captured at `target/cache-baseline.json` on the SAME canary host. See `crates/verter_bench/benches/cache_baseline.rs` for the measurement harness.
pre_stage1_notes: fact_validation_warm_hit_count == 0 because no fact-based cache exists yet (Stage 3 introduces facts; Stage 6d wires validation).
fact_validation_miss_count == num_components on the cold pass (every component missed because no fact-validated cache existed at query time).
materialise_cardinality_per_owner == num_components today (one MaterializeStructureDb entry per owner-instance of the shared dep); Stage 5 inverts to == 1 (cross-owner reuse per R7).
candidate_set_size_histogram has only the "1" bin populated today; Stage 5 multi-candidate storage grows the histogram up to the R20 cap = 4.

Per-component timings (cold_ms, warm_ms, p50/p95/p99) live in `target/cache-baseline.json` after running the bench. The Stage 7 canary re-runs the bench on the canary host and compares against the locally-generated p50/p95/p99 envelope. The committed snapshot does NOT pin latency numbers because Windows hosts (Defender-on / Defender-off) and CI hosts produce different absolute timings.

stage_6d_must_change.fact_validation_warm_hit_count: > 0 (≥ 98 % warm hit on second pass per Stage 7 canary)
stage_6d_must_change.candidate_set_size_histogram: Multi-bin distribution under N≥8 × M≥8 stress per R20

stage_7_canary_thresholds.repo_warm_second_pass_p99_ms: ≤ 1.0× Stage-0 p50 on the same host
